# lucidity_temp_buffer (Data Source)

Reads the current status of a temporary buffer by its buffer ID, including one requested outside Terraform. Useful to check a buffer is ACTIVE before starting a restore, e.g. in a `check` block.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lucidity_temp_buffer" "restore" {
  buffer_id = "buf-abc123def456"
}

output "restore_buffer_ready" {
  value = data.lucidity_temp_buffer.restore.status == "ACTIVE"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `buffer_id` (String) Lucidity's identifier for the buffer.

### Read-Only

- `current_free_space_in_gib` (Number) Current free space reported for the buffer, in GiB.
- `failure_reason` (String) Why the buffer failed, when status is FAILED.
- `instance_id` (String) The instance the buffer belongs to.
- `status` (String) PROVISIONING, ACTIVE, REVOKED, or FAILED.
